subject.title: fix(gateway): keep worker bootstrap failure details UTF-16 safe

question: After the regression is repaired, should this deterministic formatting-only change receive an explicit proof override, or must the contributor demonstrate the error through a real SSH worker bootstrap?
rationale: Repository policy requires real behavior proof for an external non-docs PR, while this change leaves transport and scripts untouched and is deterministically reachable through the production failure projection.

options.title: Override after test repair
options.body: Grant a narrow proof override once the caller-level regression demonstrably fails on raw slicing and passes with UTF-16-safe truncation.

options.title: Require live worker output
options.body: Keep the proof gate until redacted exact-head output shows the malformed boundary corrected during a real SSH worker bootstrap failure.

recommendation.title: Override after test repair
recommendation.body: Grant a narrow proof override once the caller-level regression demonstrably fails on raw slicing and passes with UTF-16-safe truncation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the affected path, authored the latest refactor, and already performed the exact-head closeout review.
